description: Checks whether a PLC, CNC, controller family, model, brand or protocol is supported and returns its page: which driver, connection settings, address syntax with examples, what can be read, tips and FAQ. Examples: "S7-1200", "CompactLogix", "MELSEC iQ-R", "FANUC 0i-F", "Modbus RTU", "IEC 104", "BACnet". Without a match it lists the supported protocols.

language.description: Answer language: the user's language if available.

query.description: Controller model or family, brand, protocol or driver name.

name: device_support
title: Check controller or protocol support
